newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan's September banking assets down 0.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's September banking assets down 0.4 pct.

text.p: Total assets of Jordanian banks fell 0.4 percent in September to 8,710 million dinars ($12.30 billion) from 8,743 million in August, the Central Bank statistical bulletin said.
Bank deposits, both local and foreign currency accounts, fell 0.53 percent in September to 5,942 million dinars ($8.39 billion) compared to the previous month.
Foreign currency deposits slipped back slightly to 2,372 million dinars from 2,367 million in August.
Year-on-year foreign currency deposits were nine percent higher from September 1995 when they stood at 2,180 million dinars, while total deposits grew by under five percent.
NOTE -- The figures cover Jordan's 21 licensed banks including six investment banks and five subsidiaries of foreign banks operating under similar Central Bank rules.
